_note: Values from SPD Java (actors/mobs/*.java). Damage/DR ranges collapsed to floor(avg) unless 'tuned' says otherwise. delay = 1/baseSpeed.

crab.name: Sewer Crab
crab.tuned: dmg 4->2, DR 2->1: at 2 attacks/tick SPD avg damage was unbeatable without RNG misses

goo.name: Goo
goo.spd: HT 100, dmg 1-8 (1-12 below half), DR 0-2, pump-up = 3x
goo.tuned: HT 100->70, enraged dmg 6. Pump every 4 acts, every 3 below half HP (v0.5: the first pumps are slower so a new player can learn the telegraph; the danger ramps in the second half)

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.spd: HT 25, dmg 2-10, DR 0-5; explodes on death for 6-12 to adjacent
skeleton.tuned: HT 25->20, dmg 4. The death explosion is a 1-tick 3x3 telegraph (5 dmg) instead of instant, so melee heroes can step away

thief.name: Crazy Thief
thief.spd: HT 20, dmg 1-10, DR 0-3; steals an item and flees
thief.tuned: steals 8 gold (dropped back when killed) instead of an item; flees at normal speed so ranged heroes can catch it

dm100.name: DM-100
dm100.tuned: zap is a 1-tick red tile at range 2-4 (5 dmg, DR applies); cooldown 3 actions

guard.name: Prison Guard
guard.spd: HT 40, dmg 4-12, DR 0-7; chains and pulls the hero
guard.tuned: HT 40->28, dmg 8->5, DR 3: once per fight pulls the hero adjacent from range 2-3

tengu.name: Tengu
tengu.spd: HT 200, dmg 6-12, DR 0-5; phase 1 teleports & throws shurikens, phase 2 bombs/fire/shockers
tengu.tuned: HT 200->90. Blinks away every 15 HP lost; shuriken = 1-tick red tile (6). Below half HP lobs a 3x3 bomb every 3 actions (2-tick fuse, 8 dmg, also hurts mobs)

bat.name: Vampire Bat
bat.spd: HT 30, dmg 5-18, DR 0-4, speed 2x, heals on hit
bat.tuned: HT 24, dmg 11->5 (it attacks twice per tick), heals 2 on a hit that gets through

shaman.name: Gnoll Shaman
shaman.tuned: magic zap = 1-tick red tile, 6 dmg ignoring DR, range 2-4, every 2 actions

spinner.name: Cave Spinner
spinner.spd: HT 50, dmg 10-20, DR 0-6; poison bite, webs
spinner.tuned: HT 32, dmg 6, bite adds 3 poison (no webs)

dm300.name: DM-300
dm300.spd: HT 300, dmg 15-25, DR 0-10; rockfall, toxic vents, supercharge with pylons
dm300.tuned: HT 160, dmg 8, DR 4 (+2 supercharged below half HP). Every 3 actions (2 supercharged) alternates rockfall (+ shape on you, 2-tick fuse, 10) and a toxic gas line (1 tick, 3 + 4 poison). No pylons.

ghoul.name: Dwarven Ghoul
ghoul.spd: HT 45, dmg 16-22, DR 0-4; rises again unless all ghouls die
ghoul.tuned: HT 40, dmg 9; the first time it dies it gets back up with half HP after 2 ticks (red tile on its corpse)

warlock.name: Dwarf Warlock
warlock.spd: HT 70, dmg 12-18, DR 0-8; shadow bolt 12-18 + weakness
warlock.tuned: HT 34; shadow bolt = 1-tick red tile, 9 dmg ignoring DR, every 2 actions

monk.name: Dwarf Monk
monk.spd: HT 70, dmg 12-25, fast attacks, DR 0-2; disarms
monk.tuned: HT 34, dmg 5, acts twice per tick

golem.name: Golem
golem.tuned: HT 75, dmg 15, DR 7, acts every 1.5 ticks

dking.name: King of Dwarves
dking.spd: HT 300, dmg 15-25, DR 0-10; summons, lifelinks, 3 phases
dking.tuned: HT 150, dmg 8, DR 5. Every 3 actions (2 when enraged below half HP, +3 dmg) alternates: marks up to 2 tiles where Risen Dwarves appear in 2 ticks (4 dmg if you stand there; only when none are left) and a shadow blast (3x3 on you, 2 ticks, 8 ignoring DR). No phases/lifelink.

ghoul_minion.name: Risen Dwarf
ghoul_minion.tuned: weak summon of the Dwarf King
